prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game VFX sprite sheet for a realistic painted sword-and-sorcery game; fast 0.65-second lightning strike animation.
Create ONE square 1536x1536 image containing EXACTLY eight separate complete animation cels arranged in a precise uniform 4-column by 2-row atlas. Each cell is 384x768, a tall 1:2 portrait. No visible grid. Row-major animation order.
Background: PERFECT UNIFORM PURE BLACK #000000 outside the emitted light, vapor and sparks, suitable for screen/additive blending. No environment or ground surface. Each effect is isolated with black margins on all sides, never crosses into another cell. The same centered vertical strike axis in every cell. The same ground contact baseline at 90 percent of each cell height. All glow must fade into pure black within cell borders. Leave generous black gaps separating all eight cels.
Subject: realistic thin irregular branching lightning, sharp angular stochastic forks like actual lightning, extremely narrow bright ivory-white core and soft restrained warm muted gold halo. Believable illuminated dusty ground vapor, small falling ember spray. Subtle fine painterly realism with physically credible atmospheric light, matching an ominous stone valley lit by a gold solar eclipse, cool gray-brown mist and warm gold rim light. NO scenery in this asset.
Cell 1 (top left): faint charged vapor at the low ground baseline and a fine partial leader descending from 10 percent height.
Cell 2 (top second): fast thin forked lightning extending from 10 percent height to the ground baseline.
Cell 3 (top third): peak strong but NARROW branched ivory lightning core, strongest localized ground light bloom, tiny dust eruption.
Cell 4 (top right): second much fainter narrow branch and tiny afterstrike, beginning to die away.
Cell 5 (bottom left): hot small dust plume centered just above the common ground baseline, fading residual filament above.
Cell 6 (bottom second): smoke and a few falling tiny warm ember specks near the ground, no full bolt.
Cell 7 (bottom third): fainter low illuminated smoke, very few specks.
Cell 8 (bottom right): almost dissipated low smoke, extremely faint; preserve the black empty upper region.
The strongest full strikes span local vertical coordinates 10 to 90 percent. Every ground puff stays centered at local x=50 percent and near local y=90 percent. Temporal continuity in dust shape and position, believable sequential animation. Keep the latter four cels sparse and dim, with near-empty upper halves.
Avoid: wavy sinusoidal ribbons, tentacles, smooth squiggles, energy spheres, neon outlines, cartoon effects, orange fire columns, symbols, circles, runes, people, weapons, text, numbers, labels, watermarks, checkerboard, colored matte, gray background, scenery, dividing lines.
notes: Reference inspected visually; no reference input sent because new asset generation. Actual image dimensions 1254x1254 based on PNG header (not requested dimensions). Ground baseline in bottom row slightly above requested 90%; inspect cropping during integration.
